source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

parts.target: A **TYRANIDS MONSTER** unit of yours that has not yet been picked to move in the phase.
parts.effect:
Whenever a model in the unit makes a [fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back), [normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move) or [advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move), it can pass through models (not **TITANIC** models) and through parts of terrain features up to 4" tall, for the rest of the phase. While doing so:

- it can pass through enemy models' [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range), but cannot end the move in it
- it can also pass through parts of terrain features taller than 4"; if it does, roll a D6 once its unit has finished moving, and on a 1 the unit is [battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock)

**Target:** A **TYRANIDS MONSTER** unit of yours that has not yet been picked to move in the phase.

**Effect:** Whenever a model in the unit makes a [fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back), [normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move) or [advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move), it can pass through models (not **TITANIC** models) and through parts of terrain features up to 4" tall, for the rest of the phase. While doing so:

- it can pass through enemy models' [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range), but cannot end the move in it
- it can also pass through parts of terrain features taller than 4"; if it does, roll a D6 once its unit has finished moving, and on a 1 the unit is [battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock)
